Class ScenarioCellPopulationDistributor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.util.ScenarioCellPopulationDistributor
public final class ScenarioCellPopulationDistributor extends Object

Scenario Cell Population Distributor

Handles the spatial initialization and hypsometric visualization of human demographics across planetary hexagonal cells:

  • Demographic Sampling: Samples imported density rasters or executes analytical procedural distribution via ProceduralPopulationEngine.
  • Hypsometric Relief invalid input: '&' Heat Tinting: Maps cell elevation, biome classification, and demographic density onto standardized cartographic color ramps.
  • Carrying Capacity Estimation: Calculates localized cellular carrying capacity ($K_{\text{cell}}$) modulated by freshwater aquifers and historical physical capital ($K_0$).

      public static void distributeInitialPopulation(List<H3Cell> cells, long totalPop, double capitalK0, String pattern, boolean isEarthPreset, long startYear, javafx.scene.image.Image customDensityImage, Scenario scenario)
      Distributes initial population across land cells according to chosen density pattern or imported map.
      Parameters:
      cells - list of hexagonal cells
      totalPop - total planetary population
      capitalK0 - initial physical capital per capita
      pattern - density pattern key (e.g. "UNBIASED_NATURAL", "URBAN_CLUSTERS")
      isEarthPreset - whether the planetary relief corresponds to Earth
      startYear - simulation start year
      customDensityImage - imported demographic raster image, or null if procedural
      scenario - scenario model configuration
